name: building-leanto-v1-overhead
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production sprite: ONE lean-to shelter viewed FROM DIRECTLY ABOVE as an orthographic ROOF PLAN, only 15 degrees tilted away from true vertical. Look down onto the broad slanted leafy roof: the roof fills almost the entire shelter footprint. Branch supports are foreshortened dots/short stubs beneath the roof, NOT long upright poles. Only a small end of the bedroll peeks out below the roof. No frontal doorway view, no side-on triangular tent silhouette, no horizon, no isometric 45-degree angle. It should look like a roof seen by a drone looking straight down, aligned north-south with square game tiles. Image 1 actual Hero berry painting is PRIMARY hand-painted watercolor STYLE ONLY; image 2 Scratch supports broad soft wet washes. Neither is subject/scenery. BIG softly merged watercolor masses, broad chunky leaf-roof patches rather than individual leaves, warm ochre wooden branches, muted sage greens, small slate bedroll, top-left late-morning light. Single cutout centered inside square canvas with 8% empty padding, opaque painted interior and real transparent exterior. NO ground patch, cast shadow, surrounding plants, berries, paper, border, text or UI. Master at least 320x320.
